<style>

/* Theme reset & breadcrumbs */
.breadcrumbs, .breadcrumb, .breadcrumb-list, .breadcrumb-item,
nav[aria-label="Хлебные крошки"],
.woocommerce-breadcrumb, .rank-math-breadcrumb, .rank-math-breadcrumbs, .yoast-breadcrumb,
.entry-header, .page-title-section { display: none !important; }
#primary, .site-main, .site-content, #content, .content-area {
  padding-top: 0 !important;
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}

/* Hero viewport */
.hero-bankrot-sroki {
  min-height: 100vh;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  position: relative;
}

/* Intro block */
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-section {
  padding: 80px 0 40px;
  background: var(--ym-bg);
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: start;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-text {
  text-align: left !important;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--ym-primary);
  padding-left: 28px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-text p {
  text-align: left !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-intro-dekor { position: relative; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-chip {
  background: var(--ym-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--ym-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 20px;
  box-shadow: var(--ym-shadow-sm);
  text-align: center;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-chip .num {
  display: block;
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-chip.myth .num { color: #dc2626; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-chip.fact .num { color: #059669; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-chip .label {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: #64748b;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-toc-wrap {
  padding: 20px 0 60px;
  text-align: center;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-toc-wrap .ym-section-subtitle {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

/* Article content */
.srok-vozrazhenij-article { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-article h2 {
  font-size: 32px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 32px 0 16px;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article p { margin: 0 0 16px; line-height: 1.7; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-article ul, .srok-vozrazhenij-article ol {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  padding-left: 24px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article li { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin: 24px 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  overflow-x: auto;
  display: block;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table caption {
  caption-side: top;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  color: var(--ym-heading);
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table th,
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table td {
  border: 1px solid var(--ym-border);
  padding: 12px 14px;
  vertical-align: top;
  text-align: left;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table th {
  background: #f1f5f9;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ym-heading);
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background: #f8fafc;
}
.srok-vozrazhenij-article a { color: var(--ym-accent); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .srok-vozrazhenij-intro-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .srok-vozrazhenij-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
